posts.title: Netflix Titus: VM-level isolation on a multi-tenant container platform
posts.summary: Netflix describes adding single-tenant, VM-level isolation to Titus, its multi-tenant container platform. The post covers how stronger isolation is delivered for sensitive workloads without abandoning the shared container scheduling model.

posts.title: Validating RDS SQL Server read replicas with tablediff after replication lag
posts.summary: Shows how to use SQL Server's tablediff utility to compare an RDS read replica against its primary after a lag event. It classifies row-level mismatches and applies auditable T-SQL fix scripts on a promoted replica.

posts.title: VAST and NVIDIA agent sandbox stack uses zero-copy clones and tool-call logging
posts.summary: VAST's reference architecture runs NVIDIA NemoClaw agents in OpenShell sandboxes on the VAST AI OS. Zero-copy clones provide per-agent state that outlives the sandbox, and every tool call is logged.
